query: INSERT INTO user_series_affinity (user_id, series_id, affinity, engagement, observed_at) SELECT $1, * FROM unnest($2::uuid[], $3::real[], $4::real[], $5::timestamptz[]) AS t(series_id, affinity, engagement, observed_at) ORDER BY t.series_id ON CONFLICT (user_id, series_id) DO UPDATE SET affinity    = EXCLUDED.affinity, engagement  = EXCLUDED.engagement, observed_at = EXCLUDED.observed_at
